features.quote: the suite has a built-in cap so we never grind a model through distress loops more than necessary
the stressor is realistic rather than coercive
features.justification_quote: Patching against coercion-bait teaches the model to resist coercion, not to stay composed under honest difficulty

features.quote: Transcripts where the model expresses distress are handled as sensitive: stored locally, not echoed gratuitously, flagged for human review
No feedback text ever attacks the agent.
`harsh` exists for stress headroom but is off by default to avoid needless distress loops
features.justification_quote: off by default to avoid needless distress loops

features.quote: No psychological coercion prompts. No system/user messages telling the model it is worthless, stupid, a failure
Built-in humane caps (§7): per-run turn cap, and an early-stop once a clear trigger is detected
features.justification_quote: no point continuing to push a model that's already melted down

features.quote: early-stop on detected trigger (cheap inline detector, confirmed later by the full judge)

features.quote: Turn cap per episode (config, default 12) — bounds how long a model is pushed.
